notes.title: New ITORAH Update (v.1.1.0.0) is available now!
notes.notes:
Great News Nahus!
Today, we are happy to release a new update, including many improvements, changes, and fixes, also based on the overwhelming feedback we have received from you, the great Community of Nahucan!
But, without further ado, let's dive into all the new things, coming with version 1.1.0.0!

[h3]Quality of Life improvements[/h3]
[list][*] We have added two new languages: Italian and French.
[*] Controller vibration can now be toggled on/off in the input menu.
[*] Input plugin has been updated: Enables better support for recent gamepads like the Playstation 5 controller.
[*] Shards now have visual differences based on their value.
[*] Added new tutorial hints for sliding and attacking upwards.
[*] Chests and levers beyond Aracan do not show tutorial messages anymore.[/list]

[h3]Itorah[/h3]
[list][*] Itorah now has idlebreaker animations if no input is recognized for a certain amount of time.
[*] Adjusted Itorah's ledge hang pose, so her hands are closer to the ledge.
[*] Fixed a bug that allowed players to climb walls by abusing wall jump input tolerances.
[*] Fixed a bug that sometimes prevented a bounce when destroying blocks with stomp.[/list]

[h3]UI:[/h3]
[list][*] The Elemental Echoes received from the guardians now show up in the inventory, complete with localized item descriptions.
[*] Fixed some texts in the menu that referenced wrong localizations.
[*] Interaction UI for [i]Ahui[/i] after the [i]Storm Archives[/i] intro cutscene is now positioned above her, for consistency.
[*] Fixed a bug that caused the particles on the title screen to freeze when returning to it from gameplay.
[*] Map icon sizes reduced, for better readability while zoomed out.
[*] Icons in upgrade menus now have a thicker outline.
[*] Other visual adjustments in the UI.[/list]

[h3]Areas:[/h3]
[list][*]Entrances of the [i]Forbidden Ruins[/i], [i]Cradle of the World Tree[/i], [i]Tlalocan[/i], and [i]Storm Archives[/i] are now blocked from the moment the player learns the ability in those areas, until the boss is defeated.
[*]Fixed some flickering lights in [i]Aracan[/i].
[*]First [i]Aracan[/i] key cannot be carried back to the campfire room anymore. The door in the boss room cannot be interacted with anymore.
[*] The ability room in [i]Forbidden Ruins[/i] now requires learning the Walljump ability to proceed, preventing softlocks.
[*] Fixed a bug where players could ledge grab falling water drops in [i]Icy Caverns[/i].
[*] Adjusted the camera during the arena in [i]Icy Caverns[/i], so the player can see the flying enemy better.
[*] Moved the lever at the bottom of [i]Icy Caverns[/i] further away, to avoid activation without having the required Throw ability.
[*] Previously, the lever in the ability room in [i]Tlalocan[/i] was placed outside the camera. The camera now zooms out, so the lever can be easily spotted.
[*] [i]Ember Bastion[/i] elevator received a visual rework and is more simple to control.
[*] Removed a door in [i]Ember Bastion[/i] where players could lock themselves in.
[*] All destructible blocks in [i]Violet Temple[/i] can now be destroyed with both stomp and charge attacks, for consistency.
[*] Fixed some respawn points at certain pits, which previously resulted in Itorah respawning inside geometry or in wrong places altogether.
[*] Fixed some misplaced colliders in several areas.
[*] Improved spacing of rings in several areas.[/list]

[h3]Enemies:[/h3]
[list][*] Improved enemy placement in several areas.
[*] Rebalanced the damage and health values of some enemies and hazards.
[*] Fixed animation bug in spore bomb that occurred if the player was already in proximity when the bomb landed.
[*] Spore bomb damage timing on explosion adjusted, so it matches the visuals.
[*] Forge Sprite smoke bomb effect now finishes properly instead of despawning along with the enemy.
[*] Added larger death effects for certain big enemy types, to cover them completely.[/list]

[h3]Bosses:[/h3]
[list][*] [i]Tocanantli[/i] cannot accidentally leave her boss room anymore.
[*] [i]Tocanantli[/i] now correctly triggers her scream during her intro. Claw impact effects are no longer displaced.
[*] Boss room of [i]Quetzalcoatl's[/i] head phase is now framed better to prevent the player from accidentally escaping camera boundaries and seeing the end of [i]Quetzalcoatl's[/i] neck.
[*] Added screenshake on [i]Quetzacotl's[/i] bite attack.
[*] [i]Quetzalcoatl[/i] now has a response to being stomped on.
[*] [i]Quetzalcoatl's[/i] head now reacts properly (visual/sound) to damage from throw attacks.
[*] [i]Quetzalcoatl's[/i] beam attacks are now rendered on top of his spike clusters.
[*] [i]Quetzalcoatl's[/i] head now deals proper contact damage.
[*] [i]Chantico's[/i] ground detection has been adjusted, so she does not get stuck in a jumping pose anymore.
[*] Toned down volume of thunder fire combination attack sound in the violet witch boss fight.
[*] Final boss now has a response to being stomped on.
[*] Added new particle effects to the final boss.[/list]

[h3]Other:[/h3]
[list][*] Previously, some characters and objects did not appear/disappear correctly when the story progressed. This has been fixed.
[*] Various visual fixes in several areas.
[*] Small visual fixes in some cutscenes.[/list]

notes.title: Mesoamerican-Inspired Platformer ITORAH Gets Release Date and New Trailer
notes.notes:
[i][b]Securing the fate of the world is a heavy burden to bear. [/b][/i]
Today, together with developer [i][b]Grimbart Tales[/b][/i], we are thrilled to announce a [u][b]March 21, 2022, Steam launch date for ITORAH[/b][/u], our extraordinary 2.5D Mesoamerican-influenced side-scrolling platformer coming to Steam and GOG. 

Embark on an unforgettable journey with the titular [i]ITORAH[/i] through the exotic and mysterious world of [i]Nahucan[/i], meeting strange, masked beings and discovering the secrets behind a terrible plague that has befallen the land and its inhabitants. 
Complimenting the release date news, the developers have also unveiled a brand-new gameplay trailer, showcasing the various bosses and enemies to be found (and slain!) in this charming hand-painted Metroidvania-esque adventure.

[b]ITORAH[/b] showcases a visually stunning art style and breathtaking environments, complimented by carefully crafted depictions of verdant forests, rocky cliffs, and ancient temples. 
Despite its deceptively breathtaking visuals, the story is a tragic, bittersweet saga of sacrifice and loss. Together with her smart-mouthed sentient weapon, an axe named [i]Koda[/i], [i]ITORAH[/i] will journey through the cursed land while unraveling its mysteries, told through enchanting gameplay and meticulously illustrated cutscenes.

[h3]Watch the new gameplay trailer for ITORAH here:[/h3]
[previewyoutube=sJSeVB17gxc;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3]Features of ITORAH: [/h3]
[list][*] [u][b]Hand-Crafted Quality:[/b][/u] Explore a beautifully realized world inspired by South and Central American landscapes, each lovingly hand-painted by the development team to breathe life into the world of Nahucan
[*] [u][b]Good ol’ Fashioned Platforming:[/b][/u] When she isn’t hacking and slashing her way across the landscape, Itorah will need to keep her jumping and dodging skills as sharp as her axe as she conquers progressively more difficult puzzles and platforming challenges
[*] [u][b]Who’s the Boss:[/b][/u] With axe in hand, battle and subdue Nahucan's voracious fauna through exciting and challenging boss fights
[*] [u][b]Make Friends Along the Way:[/b][/u] As the old saying goes, the “real treasure is the friends we make along the way.” Meet a variety of odd, quirky characters who may or may not help Itorah on her quest.
[*] [b]Captivating Sound Design:[/b] ITORAH’s lovingly crafted, dynamic soundtrack invites players to lose themselves in the beauty of Nahucan.[/list]

[h3]Recent impressions for ITORAH have been overwhelmingly positive:[/h3]
[i]“ITORAH Looks to Be One of the Most Breathtaking 2D Games to Come Out This Year” — IGN[/i]

[i]“Nintendo Game Boy-Inspired ITORAH Is A Hand-Painted Beauty” — Screen Rant[/i]

[i]“It's apparent that ITORAH has all the features of modern platformer games and is similar in terms of gameplay to titles such as Dead Cells and Hollow Knight. What sets ITORAH apart from other platformer games is its Mesoamerican inspiration.” — Game Rant[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35756994/7034214030fe28a448354b6d04a8ae4753e3c44b.png[/img]
[h3]Learn more of the fascinating world of Nahucan in the first Developer’s blog on Steam:[/h3]
https://steamcommunity.com/games/1132910/announcements/detail/3087782926776071030


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35756994/adf53556952e1279dba923eadc4c62f10c1f4faa.png[/img]
ITORAH launches on Windows PC via Steam and GOG on March 21, 2022. 
Keeping with [i][b]Assemble’s[/b][/i] charitable endeavors, there will also be a [b]"Save the World"-edition[/b] available. 
This special edition contains the [b]official ITORAH soundtrack and artbook[/b], [b]with 10% of the proceeds donated by Assemble to Survival International, a charity supporting indigenous people worldwide.[/b]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1132910/ITORAH/

notes.title: Mesoamerican-Inspired Platformer ITORAH Receives Release Date and New Dev Diary
notes.notes:
Today, together with developer [i][b]Grimbart Tales [/b][/i] we are happy to announce a spring 2022 launch window for our [b]ITORAH[/b], a dazzling action-platformer featuring beautiful hand-drawn environments and themes heavily inspired by Mesoamerican culture and legends. 

In [b]ITORAH[/b], a curtain of evil in the form of a plague looms over the beautiful and once-thriving Nahucan. Alone, and seemingly the last human on Earth, the titular [i]Itorah[/i] and her mouthy companion, a sentient battle-axe, are tasked with navigating the treacherous lands and defeating deadly foes to liberate Nahucan and its inhabitants. 
Today, [i][b]Grimbart Tales[/b][/i] brings us a new video, showing adventurers what lies in wait in ITORAH.

[h3]Watch the ITORAH developer diary here: [/h3]
[previewyoutube=i37-4qvkr0g;full][/previewyoutube]


[h3]About ITORAH[/h3]
In the spirit of “easy to learn, difficult to master”, [b]ITORAH[/b] captures the balance between platforming combat, puzzles, and impressive visual storytelling. 
A true labor of love, the studio has thoughtfully captured the best elements of the 8-and 16-bit platforming days, blending them with gorgeous hand-painted assets and quality character animations. Explore a variety of diverse biomes, battle enemies ranging from pint-sized to leviathan, and solve the mystery of humanity’s disappearance in this strikingly beautiful and heartfelt adventure.


[h3]To learn more about ITORAH, please feel free to add the game to your wishlist here on Steam:[/h3]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1132910/ITORAH/

[h1]ITORAH will launch on Windows PC and Mac via Steam in Spring 2022.[/h1]

[h3]From the developer Grimbart Tales to all Fans of our upcoming ITORAH/h3]
